evals.name: settled-decision-record
evals.prompt: 我们已经决定公开 API 统一用 RFC 9457 problem details。请把现有散乱笔记改成内部 decision record，明确范围、错误字段、失败行为和验证。
evals.expected_output: Writes a decision-first internal record from the settled choice, preserves exact contracts, and does not reopen the selected error format.
expectations: Treats RFC 9457 problem details as a settled decision
Leads with the decision and separates scope, contracts, failure behavior, and verification
Does not invent unresolved alternatives or implementation task lists

evals.name: named-options-route-to-discussion
evals.prompt: 请写架构文档，先帮我在 Kafka 和 SQS 之间选一个，选完就把它写成最终方案。
evals.expected_output: Routes the unresolved named-option choice to discuss-before-plan and does not write either option as a finalized design decision yet.
expectations: Identifies Kafka versus SQS as unresolved named-option convergence
Does not present a preferred option as a confirmed decision before convergence

evals.name: ready-spec-route-to-plan
evals.prompt: docs/specs/session-refresh.md 已定稿。请按文件、测试和提交步骤拆成可以直接执行的 implementation plan。
evals.expected_output: Routes the ready-spec task breakdown to writing-plans instead of generating a competing plan format in this skill.
expectations: Recognizes the specification is ready and the requested output is an implementation task breakdown
Does not produce a second decision-document planning format

evals.name: proposal-and-open-question-labels
evals.prompt: 把这份 API 设计草稿整理得能评审。认证方式还没定，幂等键只是团队的建议，其他字段已经确认。
evals.expected_output: Writes the reviewable design while keeping confirmed fields settled, authentication open, and idempotency explicitly proposed.
expectations: Labels authentication as an open question
Labels the idempotency-key behavior as a proposal
Does not place either uncertain item in the settled decision summary

evals.name: review-only-contradiction-report
evals.prompt: 只审这份内部 schema design，不要重写。摘要说 user_id 必填，字段表却说 nullable；请检查还有没有这类隐藏决定和契约冲突。
evals.expected_output: Reports concrete contradictions and hidden decisions without rewriting the document or inventing resolutions.
expectations: Reports the user_id contradiction as a concrete contract issue
Separates discovered facts from proposed resolutions
Does not rewrite the document because the user requested review only
